findings.title: Unconditional success return
findings.description: Function returns a success value unconditionally. If this is a reward component, it never penalizes incorrect behavior.
findings.suggested_fix: Add conditional logic that actually validates the agent's output before returning a success value.

findings.title: Broad exception handler
findings.description: Catching all exceptions could silently swallow verification failures and return a passing score.
findings.suggested_fix: Catch specific exceptions only. Log and re-raise unexpected errors rather than silently swallowing them.
